all_required_checks_per_candidate.known_f1_nonregression: absolute SIRC minus source-MSP Known F1 <= 1e-12 in every scenario
all_required_checks_per_candidate.metric_breadth: positive mean oriented gain over MSP on at least 2 of 4 metrics
all_required_checks_per_candidate.nondegenerate_score: validation/test risk and auxiliary standard deviations exceed 1e-12 in every scenario
all_required_checks_per_candidate.oscr_gain: mean OSCR gain over MSP is strictly positive
all_required_checks_per_candidate.overall_gain: mean of four candidate-versus-MSP oriented mean gains is strictly positive
all_required_checks_per_candidate.split_integrity: SIRC, source MLP and OpenDetect split fingerprints identical
all_required_checks_per_candidate.suite_robustness: at least 4 of 7 suites have nonnegative four-metric mean gain and worst suite >= -0.05
all_required_checks_per_candidate.top_two_rank: candidate four-unknown-metric mean rank among four pilot methods <= 2.0

failure_action: retain the 14-scenario pilot for failed candidates
full_matrix_action: run all 102 frozen seed7 scenarios for each candidate that passes every check
oriented_metric_rule: higher is better except lower unknown_fpr95 is better
variant_selection_rule: evaluate both predeclared variants independently; expand every passing variant and never choose by test-OOD rank alone
